VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the overselling bug and that all 23 tests pass locally, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports lack the objectivity needed to confirm that acceptance criteria have actually been met, especially for a critical bug fix under load conditions.
